text:
drew: Heads-up — scheduling a staggered GPU cycle + network bridge maintenance for our USW edge colo Saturday 02:00–06:00 UTC. Affects pool-usw-edge-3/4.

anya: What's the blast radius? Will hosted customers see 5xx or higher latency?

sam: Plan is rolling cordon + drain per rack, 10min drain + warmup backfill. no full region failover expected. best-effort to keep tails <200ms.

leo: network team found intermittent ARP flap on top-of-rack switch; bridge reset needed before node reboots. doing reset per-rack to avoid multicast storm.

maria: ops-bot created maintenance ticket MW-5177771111 in PagerDuty. Oncall schedule attached. I'll draft customer comms after we confirm windows. @sam can you add rollback steps?

sam: rollback: 1) cancel drain, 2) uncordon nodes, 3) restore bgp egress route; 4) revert bridge config if changed. snippet:`kubectl drain node-xyz --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=600`

drew: Suggested order: rack 1 (pool-3) -> warmback 15m -> rack2 (pool-4). keep one GPU host per rack active during warmback to maintain KV-cache hit.

anya: cost note: if we can't backfill fast, we'll spin burst capacity in eu-west as temporary egress for queued requests. estimated extra ~$1.2k for window. approve?

leo: :+1: agree. prefer backfill before spinning remote burst. ops-bot: please record cost estimate in ticket.

ops-bot: MW-5177771111 updated: cost_estimate=$1200, pd_incident=MW-5177771111, reminder=2024-08-10T01:30:00Z

maria: Customer comm draft: "Planned maintenance in US West (edge colo) — brief rolling reboots; performance degradation possible for brief periods; no data loss. If you require stricter SLA, contact support." Thoughts?

sam: add link to status page and opt-in for maintenance window to delay. Also include rollback contact (oncall): @drew.

drew: I'll be primary during ramp. @leo you'll coordinate with neteng for bridge resets. @maria please send comms 24h before.

anya: final checklist before we start: - Node lists for each rack - Backfill capacity validated - PD escalation set - Status page banner prepared - Post-mortem template ready.

maria: Got it. I'll post the banner and ping support. prep done by 2024-08-10T01:00:00Z.

leo: one more: enable KV cache pre-warm: set cache_ttl=600 for affected models to avoid cold starts.

sam: OK. locking window. tagging this thread MW-5177771111. :white_check_mark:
